BL-0.1.4-004-S17.title: Audit Log Hash Chain Integrity Implementation
BL-0.1.4-004-S17.description: Implement hash chaining across audit log entries so each record includes a hash of the previous record, enabling tamper-evident verification of append-only integrity.

BL-0.1.4-004-S18.title: Audit Log Write Pipeline Optimization (Batching and Async)
BL-0.1.4-004-S18.description: Enhance audit logging with asynchronous and batched write capabilities to MongoDB to reduce latency impact on request handling while preserving strict append-only guarantees.

BL-0.1.4-004-S19.title: Audit Log Query and Filtering Interface (Internal)
BL-0.1.4-004-S19.description: Implement internal query utilities for audit logs supporting filtering by correlation_id, tool_name, event_type, and time range to enable debugging, QA, and operational analysis without violating immutability.

BL-0.1.4-004-S20.title: Audit Log Access Control and Redaction Enforcement
BL-0.1.4-004-S20.description: Implement access control rules and automatic redaction for sensitive fields (e.g., PHI) when audit logs are read, ensuring compliance with HIPAA Safe Harbor and existing de-identification patterns.
